garment: Autumn outerwear: oversized coat and jacket
summary: Autumn outerwear shot on an industrial steel bridge under soft overcast light, with a cool cinematic grade. Oversized layered coats, wind in the hair and a relaxed, direct model attitude.
lighting: Soft overcast daylight, no hard shadows, cool teal grade with muted contrast. Optional black and white variants for low-angle frames.
settingNote: Riveted steel bridge, red brick warehouses and wet asphalt, with barriers and open sky kept in frame.
styling: Oversized coats over tailored layers: trench, tweed-look jacket, belted utility jacket. Black trousers or long skirt, a white roll neck and slate blazer as base layers. Minimal jewellery, loose natural hair.
casting: One or two female models, editorial, natural hair, direct or distant gaze, comfortable moving in oversized outerwear
